key_insight: Agentic distributional regression uses a language-model agent to write compact, inspectable programs that estimate conditional response distributions.
engineering_relevance: The resulting estimator can be evaluated independently of the agent, offering a deployable formula for uncertainty-aware prediction.
method: Build conditional densities from a library of parametric distributions, mixtures and multivariate factorizations.
Let the agent choose model structure and fitting procedures under limits on program operations and constants.
Analyze finite-sample error, independent-validation selection and asymptotic behavior under explicit assumptions.
evidence_signal: Across simulations, twelve real datasets and one dataset collected after the agents’ training data, ADR with Claude Opus 5.5 achieved the best average performance among the methods considered.
watch_item: The theoretical guarantees depend on complexity, optimization and stability assumptions that require verification in practical implementations.
paper_title: Agentic Distributional Regression: Conditional Density Estimation through Agent-Written Programs
